create_LeRobotEpisodicLogger: create a LeRobotEpisodicLogger with task_id, output_directory, image and proprioceptive observation keys, and features dict
start_episode_LeRobotEpisodicLogger: start a new episode on the LeRobotEpisodicLogger with an episode index before recording steps
record_step_LeRobotEpisodicLogger: record a timestep step with action, observation, and timestamp data to the LeRobotEpisodicLogger
finish_episode_LeRobotEpisodicLogger: finish the current episode on the LeRobotEpisodicLogger after all steps have been recorded
convert_lerobot_data_to_mcap: convert a LeRobot dataset to MCAP format with episode timestamps and optional episode limit
